SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, br.brand_name AS brandName, s.store_address AS storeAddress, s.store_lat AS storeLat, s.store_lng AS storeLng, s.store_image_url AS storeImageUrl,
b.benefit_id AS benefitId, b.benefit_type AS benefitType, b.benefit_content AS benefitContent, b.benefit_discount AS benefitDiscount, b.benefit_condition AS benefitCondition,
ROUND( 6371000 * ACOS( LEAST( 1, GREATEST( -1, COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(s.store_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s.store_lng) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(s.store_lat)) ) ) ) ) AS distanceMeter,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wish w WHERE w.member_no = #{memberNo} AND w.store_id = s.store_id AND w.wish_type = 'STORE' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isLiked
FALSE AS isLiked
FROM store s JOIN brand br ON s.brand_id = br.brand_id JOIN benefit b ON s.store_id = b.store_id WHERE s.store_lat IS NOT NULL AND s.store_lng IS NOT NULL AND (b.start_date IS NULL OR b.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ) t WHERE t.distanceMeter < #{radius} ORDER BY t.distanceMeter ASC, t.storeId ASC, t.benefitId ASC LIMIT 20
